args.subject: Quick update: HIIT class I tried last night
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to share a quick update from a HIIT workout class I took last night. I went with my colleague Alex to the new fitness center downtown. We worked through intense circuits — lots of burpees, squats, and sprints. It was challenging but left me feeling really energized; a great way to shake up my usual routine.

If you’re interested, I’d love for you to join next time!

Best,

args.subject: Loved this morning's yoga class
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I tried a new yoga class this morning at the downtown studio. The instructor, Rachel, led a relaxing flow that really helped me unwind after a hectic week. I loved the calming atmosphere and the soothing music — it was exactly what I needed. Highly recommend giving it a try!

Best,

args.subject: Tried a carbonara from 'The Italian Kitchen: Pasta Perfection'
args.body:
Hi Bob,

I tried a carbonara recipe from the book "The Italian Kitchen: Pasta Perfection" — a classic with a creamy egg sauce, crispy pancetta, and a sprinkle of freshly cracked black pepper. It turned out delicious, and I can't wait to make it again for friends.

Thought you'd enjoy hearing about it!

Best,

args.subject: Cooking class last night — homemade pasta & Bolognese
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to share what I learned at the cooking class last night. We made homemade pasta from scratch and a rich, flavorful Bolognese sauce. The chef, Maria, shared excellent tips on perfecting the pasta dough texture—how long to rest the dough, the right hydration, and kneading until it’s smooth and elastic. The Bolognese was slow-simmered with beef, tomatoes, and aromatics for deep, savory flavor.

It turned out delicious. I’d be happy to make it for you sometime or send the recipe and measurements if you want to try it yourself.

Best,

args.body:

Quick update: I had brunch with my childhood friend Sarah at the cozy cafe on Elm Street. We had avocado toast and lattes while catching up.

Best,
